name: Iridium NEXT
tagline: Polar LEO comms — 75 sats, GMDSS partner, global voice/data
description: Second-generation Iridium constellation — 75 satellites at 780 km in 6 polar planes, deployed 2017-2019 to replace the original 1998 Iridium fleet. Carries voice + data + machine-to-machine + sat-phone services. The backbone of GMDSS (Global Maritime Distress and Safety System) — every ocean-going vessel's emergency comms run through Iridium. The collision of the original Iridium 33 with derelict Cosmos 2251 in 2009 was the first known satellite-to-satellite collision in history.
